reconstruction: Candidate records are baselineRecords with the listed exact differences applied; null removes an entry. Both full sorted inventories were independently read and hashed.
limitations: This compares the current retained dependency trees. The baseline actor subsequently reinstalled dependencies; this is not a preserved hash inventory of the initial baseline install.
It compares regular-file bytes, names, permissions and symlink targets without following links. Ownership, timestamps, allocation and inode numbers are not cross-arm equality criteria.

Equal current package bytes do not establish that every historical install side effect or environmental value was identical. No installs, package lifecycle scripts, model calls or runtime checks were rerun.
